Aromatic Hebs Catalogue — Tower Editions

Because culinary herbs are typically harvested in small, high-flavour portions, our Herb 1000 Module is subdivided into 8 bays. Plant one herb across all bays for bulk harvests or mix up to 8 different herbs for a living spice rack.

All herbs are bred for:

  • ≤ 25cm mature height.
  • Fast regrowth after cutting.
  • High essential-oil concentration for maximum aroma in small harvests.
